lines.en: I walk toward the monsters.
You're not my target.
I search along the hall.

lines.zh: 脚步声在瓷砖上很清脆。
lines.en: My steps ring on the tiles.
I pull the door open and peek in.

lines.zh: 半张脸是破的，另一半还好。
lines.en: Half this face is broken. The rest is fine.

lines.zh: 我绕开桌子，不碰倒东西。
lines.en: I go round the tables without knocking things.
I'll check over there.
This outfit hasn't been cleaned in ages.
I walk steadily, step by step.
There's a shadow moving on the wall.
I pass in front of the stage.
I stand at the door and listen.
My fingers are a bit loose.
Nothing much inside now.
I wait for the next shadow.
I tilt my head; something clicks.
This purple is nearly washed out.
The lamp reflects off my face.
Something stirs under the floor.
You're not a monster, so don't worry.

lines.zh: 我只找那些会动的影子。
lines.en: I only go after the shadows that move.
Just stand to one side.
Half my face is broken.
Can you see those things?
These eyes don't mean what they show.
You have a weapon. Better than me.

lines.zh: 我认得这里的每一间房。
lines.en: I know every room here.

lines.zh: 你身上有血味，不是你的。
lines.en: You smell of blood, and it isn't yours.
Step back. I need to get past.
Another crack in the shell.
I barely stagger.
Something came loose in a joint.
I listed, then steadied.
You hit hard.
The fabric tore.
I press a hand to the damage.
That half of my face is worse now.
I'll keep walking.
There's pain, but it doesn't matter.
I chase monsters, not snacks.
I don't need what's in your hand.
Guitar in hand, I hunt monsters.
I smell oil. It bothers me.

lines.zh: 你放下去，我就当没看见。
lines.en: Put it down and I won't notice.
I'm only interested in shadows.
Keep it away. Thanks.
Don't shake. I don't bite.
That's useless to me.
Take it back. Really.
Sorry, I didn't see you.
This shell is a bit hard.
You bumped me and I hit the wall.
That arm doesn't bend much.
I turn sideways to let you pass.
I barely get knocked aside.
My apologies for that.
There's a screw of mine on the floor.
Let's not block the doorway.
You step back, so do I.
I don't do that.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是为这个做的。
lines.en: This body wasn't made for it.
It's awkward just with you watching.
It's as old as I am.
Nobody's going to like this part.
The joints are stiff. Don't force it.
Afterwards we go back to our own work.
I won't remember this.
Something moved in the corner. Ignore it.
I pick up a severed hand.
This shouldn't be on the floor.
I set it back on the table.
I'll save this cloth for you.
I'm afraid I'll crush it.
I keep what gets left behind.
Stiff fingers. I pick it slowly.
That screw is mine.

lines.zh: 我把它放进胸口的盒子。
lines.en: I put it in the chest compartment.
The floor's better clean.
That shadow moved. That's the one.
Found my target. Not you.
It moves too much like a living thing.
I crouch low and close in.

lines.zh: 我认得这股味，是那些东西。
lines.en: I know this smell. It's those things.
It's behind the door. I heard it.
This hand is about to be used.
It's smaller than me, but quicker.
Locked on. Don't interfere.
Clear the way. I'm going through.

lines.zh: 它藏进阴影了，我看见了。
lines.en: It slipped into shadow. I saw.
Twenty a hit is enough to push it back.
I don't care whose it is.
The shadow on the wall is it.
I move first, so it must dodge.
I follow that shadow.
It's behind the shelves.
I'm not fast, but I don't give up.
There's a drag mark on the floor.
I've blocked the doorway.
It changes direction. So do I.

lines.zh: 我听见指甲刮墙的声音。
lines.en: I hear nails scraping the wall.

lines.zh: 这个房间只有一个出口。
lines.en: This room has only one exit.

lines.zh: 它躲到灯照不到的地方了。
lines.en: It's hiding where the light doesn't reach.

lines.zh: 我在这类环境里待了很久。
lines.en: I've been in places like this a long time.
Its breathing is unsteady.
Further on it has no retreat.
I pushed the table out of the way.
That eye is watching me.
I'm going to drive it out.
My fingers are ready.

lines.zh: 它从窗户走了，我绕过去。
lines.en: It went out the window. I go around.
It's quieter than before.
It's in the next room.
I raise a hand and swing.
That one was for it.
My fist landed on it.
It dodged half of it.

lines.zh: 关节响了一声，还是打中。
lines.en: The joint clicked, but it landed.
I shove it away from the door.
I slapped the thing aside.
No weapon. Just my hands.
Twenty a hit. Enough.
It hit the wall.
I grab hold of its shape.
I plant a foot on it.

lines.zh: 这一下是替这里的人打的。
lines.en: That one was for the people here.
It's backing away.
My hand is a bit crooked.
I pried its hand open.
Another, and it backed off.
My hand is caught on it.
That one hit the wall.
I step down from the display.
Lights on. Patrol begins.
I watch this floor.
I didn't just appear.
I raise my eyes and scan.
Same outfit as always.
There's other movement in the hall.
I stand in the middle of the hall.
There's a draft. The door isn't shut.
I'm on watch tonight.
My eyes lit first.
You two carry on. I'll do a round.
My ankle turned on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进关节，我走不动了。
lines.en: Water filled my joints. I can't walk.
The blast threw me into the shelves.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，我拔出来了。
lines.en: An arrow in my shoulder. I pulled it out.
That light stopped me briefly.

lines.zh: 我不吃饭，只靠这里的电。
lines.en: I don't eat. I run on the building's power.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的线路走了一圈。
lines.en: Lightning ran through my wiring.

lines.zh: 掉下去时我还想着下一间。
lines.en: Falling, I was still thinking of the next room.
